in_hebrew.name: Hurley
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, Dark-haired One
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hurley הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish word 'O'hUrghail' meaning 'descendant of the dark-haired one'. In the Irish legend of Fionn Mac Cumhaill, Hurley was a champion warrior with dark hair.

in_greek.name: Hurley
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong, Dark-haired One
in_greek.long_meaning: Hurley είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Irish word 'O'hUrghail' meaning 'descendant of the dark-haired one'. In the Irish legend of Fionn Mac Cumhaill, Hurley was a champion warrior with dark hair.

in_latin.name: Hurley
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong, Dark-haired One
in_latin.long_meaning: Hurley est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Irish word 'O'hUrghail' meaning 'descendant of the dark-haired one'. In the Irish legend of Fionn Mac Cumhaill, Hurley was a champion warrior with dark hair.
